g.text: A Rate Limiter is a mechanism that controls how many requests a client can make to a server within a specific time period. It is used to prevent abuse,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: protect servers from overload, ensure fair resource usage, and improve system stability.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Suppose an API allows 100 requests per minute for each user.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: ❌ 101st request within the same minute → Rejected (usually with HTTP 429: Too Many Requests)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 1. Sliding window: Stores the timestamp of every request. Removes timestamps older than the configured window.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2. Fixed Window: Limit: 100 requests/minute, 100 requests at 12:00:59 and another 100 at 12:01:00 are all allowed.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 3. Sliding Window Counter: Combines the current and previous windows using a weighted calculation.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 4. Token Bucket: Tokens are added to a bucket at a fixed rate., Each request consumes one token., Requests are allowed only if tokens are available.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 5. Leaky Bucket: Requests enter a queue (bucket)., They are processed at a constant rate.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
